title.zh: 卷四十三 本紀第四十三: 順帝六
title.raw: 卷四十三 本紀第四十三: 順帝六 Volume 43 Annals 43: Shundi 6

sentences.zh: 順帝六

translations.literal: Shundi 6
translations.idiomatic: Shundi 6

sentences.zh: 十三年春正月庚午朔，用帝師請，釋放在京罪囚。

translations.literal: Thirteenth year, spring, first month, gengwu new moon; at the Imperial Preceptor's request, criminal prisoners in the capital were released.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, on the new moon of gengwu in the first month of spring, at the request of the Imperial Preceptor, criminals imprisoned in the capital were released.

sentences.zh: 以中書添設平章政事哈麻為平章政事，參知政事悟良哈臺為右丞，參知政事烏古孫良楨為左丞。

translations.literal: The additionally appointed associate chief minister of the Secretariat Hami was made chief minister; the vice chief minister Wulianghatai was made right vice director; the vice chief minister Ouyang Sun Liangzhen was made left vice director.
translations.idiomatic: Hami, the additionally appointed associate chief minister of the Secretariat, was promoted to chief minister; Vice Chief Minister Wulianghatai was appointed right vice director; and Vice Chief Minister Ouyang Sun Liangzhen was appointed left vice director.

sentences.zh: 詔印造中統元寶交鈔一百九十萬錠、至元鈔一十萬錠。

translations.literal: An edict ordered printing of 1,900,000 ingots of Zhongtong yuanbao paper currency and 100,000 ingots of Zhiyuan paper currency.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the printing of 1.9 million ingots of Zhongtong yuanbao notes and 100,000 ingots of Zhiyuan notes.

sentences.zh: 辛未，命悟良哈臺、烏古孫良楨兼大司農卿，給分司農司印。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, Wulianghatai and Ouyang Sun Liangzhen were ordered to hold concurrent posts as directors of the Grand Agribureau; seals of the branch Agribureau were issued to them.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, Wulianghatai and Ouyang Sun Liangzhen were ordered to serve concurrently as directors of the Grand Agribureau, and seals of the branch agribureau were issued to them.

sentences.zh: 西自西山，南至保定、河間，北至檀、順州，東至遷民鎮，凡系官地及元管各處屯田，悉從分司農司立法佃種，合用工價、牛具、農器、谷種、召募農夫諸費，給鈔五百萬錠，以供其用。

translations.literal: From the Western Hills in the west, to Baoding and Hejian in the south, to Tan and Shun prefectures in the north, and to Qianmin Fort in the east, all government lands and garrison farms formerly under various jurisdictions were to be leased for cultivation according to the branch Agribureau's regulations; for labor costs, oxen, farm tools, seed grain, and expenses for recruiting farmers, 5,000,000 ingots of paper currency were provided for their use.
translations.idiomatic: From the Western Hills in the west to Baoding and Hejian in the south, Tan and Shun prefectures in the north, and Qianmin Fort in the east, all government land and garrison farms formerly under various jurisdictions were to be leased for cultivation under the branch agribureau's regulations; five million ingots of paper currency were allocated to cover labor costs, oxen, farm tools, seed grain, and the recruitment of farmers.

sentences.zh: 旌表真定路槁城縣董氏婦貞節。

translations.literal: The chaste conduct of a woman of the Dong clan in Gaocheng County, Zhending Circuit, was publicly honored.
translations.idiomatic: The chaste conduct of a woman of the Dong clan in Gaocheng County, Zhending Circuit, was publicly commended.

sentences.zh: 壬申，命陜西行省平章政事卜答失裏為總兵官。

translations.literal: On renshen day, Budashiri, chief minister of the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat, was appointed overall military commander.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, Budashiri, chief minister of the Shaanxi branch secretariat, was appointed overall military commander.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，享於太廟。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 以皇第二子育於太尉眾家奴家，賜眾家奴及乳母鈔各一千錠。

translations.literal: Because the emperor's second son was being raised in the household of Grand Marshal Zhong Jianu, Zhong Jianu and the wet nurse were each granted 1,000 ingots of paper currency.
translations.idiomatic: Because the emperor's second son was being raised in the household of Grand Marshal Zhong Jianu, Zhong Jianu and the wet nurse were each granted one thousand ingots of paper currency.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，重建穆清閣。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, the Muhua Pavilion was rebuilt.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, the Muhua Pavilion was rebuilt.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，命中書右丞禿禿以兵討商州賊。

translations.literal: On yihai day, Toto, right vice director of the Secretariat, was ordered to take troops to suppress the bandits of Shangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, Toto, right vice director of the Secretariat, was ordered to lead troops against the bandits of Shangzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙子，方國珍復降。

translations.literal: On bingzi day, Fang Guozhen submitted again.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, Fang Guozhen submitted again.

sentences.zh: 以司農司舊署賜哈麻。

translations.literal: The former offices of the Agribureau were granted to Hami.
translations.idiomatic: The former offices of the Agribureau were granted to Hami.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，中書省臣言：「近立分司農司，宜於江浙、淮東等處召募能種水田及修築圍堰之人各一千名為農師，教民播種。

translations.literal: On gengchen day, a minister of the Secretariat said: "Since the branch Agribureau was recently established, in Jiangzhe, Huaidong, and other regions one thousand persons each skilled in planting paddy fields and building dikes should be recruited as agricultural instructors to teach the people sowing."
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, a minister of the Secretariat said: "Now that the branch agribureau has been established, in Jiangzhe, Huaidong, and other regions we should recruit one thousand persons each who are skilled at planting paddy fields and building dikes to serve as agricultural instructors and teach the people how to sow."

sentences.zh: 宜降空名添設職事敕牒一十二道，遣使賫往其地，有能募農民一百名者授正九品，二百名者正八品，三百名者從七品，即書填流官職名給之，就令管領所募農夫，不出四月十五日，俱至田所，期年為滿，即放還家。

translations.literal: Twelve blank supplementary appointment patents for regular offices should be issued, and envoys sent bearing them to those regions; one who could recruit one hundred farmers would receive rank 9a, two hundred farmers rank 8a, three hundred farmers rank 7b; the regular office title would be filled in and granted at once, and he would be put in charge of the farmers recruited; all were to reach the fields before the fifteenth day of the fourth month; after one year the term would be complete and they would be released to return home.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve blank supplementary appointment patents for regular offices should be issued and envoys sent with them to those regions: anyone who recruited one hundred farmers would receive rank 9a, two hundred farmers rank 8a, and three hundred farmers rank 7b; the regular office title would be filled in and granted on the spot, and he would be placed in charge of the farmers he had recruited. All were to reach the fields before the fifteenth day of the fourth month; after one year the term would expire and they would be released to return home.

sentences.zh: 其所募農夫，每名給鈔十錠。

translations.literal: For each farmer recruited, ten ingots of paper currency would be given.
translations.idiomatic: Each farmer recruited would receive ten ingots of paper currency.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: The proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 以杜秉彜為中書參知政事。

translations.literal: Du Bingyi was appointed vice chief minister of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Du Bingyi was appointed vice chief minister of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，太陰犯太微垣。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, the moon transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, the moon transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以武衛所管鹽臺屯田八百頃，除軍見種外，荒閑之地，盡付分司農司。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, of the 800 qing of Yantai garrison farm land under the Martial Guard, apart from what the troops were already cultivating, all idle wasteland was turned over to the branch Agribureau.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, of the eight hundred qing of Yantai garrison farm land under the Martial Guard, all idle wasteland beyond what the troops were already cultivating was turned over to the branch agribureau.

sentences.zh: 答失八都魯克復襄陽、樊城有功，升四川行省右丞，賜金系腰一。

translations.literal: Dashibadu'er, for meritorious recovery of Xiangyang and Fancheng, was promoted to right vice director of the Sichuan Branch Secretariat and granted one gold belt plaque.
translations.idiomatic: For his meritorious recovery of Xiangyang and Fancheng, Dashibadu'er was promoted to right vice director of the Sichuan branch secretariat and granted a gold belt plaque.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，知樞密院事老章克復南陽唐州，賜金一錠、銀一十錠、鈔一千錠、幣帛各五十匹。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, for recovering Nanyang and Tangzhou, Lao Zhang, director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was granted one ingot of gold, ten ingots of silver, 1,000 ingots of paper currency, and fifty bolts each of silks and fabrics.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, for recovering Nanyang and Tangzhou, Lao Zhang, director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was granted one ingot of gold, ten ingots of silver, one thousand ingots of paper currency, and fifty bolts each of silks and fabrics.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，熒惑、太白、辰星聚於奎宿。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, Mars, Venus, and Mercury gathered in the Kui mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, Mars, Venus, and Mercury gathered in the Kui mansion.

sentences.zh: 二月丁未，祭先農。

translations.literal: Second month, on dingwei day, the First Farmer was sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the dingwei day, sacrifices were offered to the First Farmer.

sentences.zh: 己酉，太陰犯軒轅。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, the moon transgressed Xuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, the moon transgressed Xuanyuan.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，太白犯熒惑。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, Venus transgressed Mars.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, Venus transgressed Mars.

sentences.zh: 壬子，太陰犯太微垣。

translations.literal: On renzi day, the moon transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, the moon transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，中書省臣言徐州民願建廟宇，生祠右丞相脫脫，從之，詔仍立脫脫《平徐勛德碑》。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, a minister of the Secretariat said the people of Xuzhou wished to build a temple and erect a living shrine to Right Chief Minister Toto; this was approved, and an edict also ordered establishment of the "Meritorious Pacification of Xu" stele for Toto.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, a minister of the Secretariat reported that the people of Xuzhou wished to build a temple and erect a living shrine to Right Chief Minister Toto; this was approved, and an edict also ordered the erection of the "Meritorious Pacification of Xu" stele for Toto.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以宣政院使篤憐帖木兒知經筵事，中書右丞悟良哈臺、左丞烏古孫良楨、參知政事杜秉彜並同知經筵事。

translations.literal: On renxu day, Duling Temür, commissioner of the Bureau of Buddhist and Tibetan Affairs, was made director of the Classics Colloquium; Right Vice Director Wulianghatai, Left Vice Director Ouyang Sun Liangzhen, and Vice Chief Minister Du Bingyi were all made associate directors of the Classics Colloquium.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, Duling Temür, commissioner of the Bureau of Buddhist and Tibetan Affairs, was appointed director of the Classics Colloquium; Right Vice Director Wulianghatai, Left Vice Director Ouyang Sun Liangzhen, and Vice Chief Minister Du Bingyi were all appointed associate directors of the Classics Colloquium.

sentences.zh: 三月己卯，命脫脫領大司農司。

translations.literal: Third month, on jimao day, Toto was ordered to head the Grand Agribureau.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the jimao day, Toto was ordered to head the Grand Agribureau.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔修大承天護聖寺，賜鈔二萬錠。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, an edict ordered repair of the Great Chengtian Protecting Sage Temple and granted 20,000 ingots of paper currency.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, an edict ordered the repair of the Great Chengtian Protecting Sage Temple and granted twenty thousand ingots of paper currency.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，命脫脫以太師開府，提調太史院、回回、漢兒司天監。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, Toto was ordered, as Grand Preceptor opening his own office, to supervise the Directorate of Astronomy, the Muslim and Han observatories.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, Toto was ordered, as grand preceptor with his own office, to supervise the Directorate of Astronomy and the Muslim and Han observatories.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以各衙門系官田地並宗仁等衛屯田地土，並付分司農司播種。

translations.literal: On jichou day, government lands attached to the various yamens and the garrison farm lands of the Zongren Guard and others were all turned over to the branch Agribureau for sowing.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, government lands attached to the various yamens and the garrison farm lands of the Zongren Guard and others were all turned over to the branch agribureau for sowing.

sentences.zh: 是月，會州、定西、靜寧、莊浪等州地震。

translations.literal: That month, Huizhou, Dingxi, Jingning, Zhuanglang, and other prefectures were struck by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Huizhou, Dingxi, Jingning, Zhuanglang, and other prefectures were struck by earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 命江浙行省左丞帖裏帖木兒、江南行臺侍御史左答納失裏招諭方國珍。

translations.literal: Tie'er Temür, left vice director of the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat, and Zuo Danashiri, attendant censor of the Jiangnan Branch Censorate, were ordered to summon and persuade Fang Guozhen.
translations.idiomatic: Tie'er Temür, left vice director of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat, and Zuo Danashiri, attendant censor of the Jiangnan branch censorate, were ordered to summon and persuade Fang Guozhen to submit.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊戌朔，命南北兵馬司各分官一員，就領通州、漷州、直沽等處巡捕官兵，往來巡邏，給分司印，一同署事，半載一更。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, wuxu new moon: each of the northern and southern military patrol offices was to assign one official to take command on the spot of patrol and arrest troops at Tongzhou, Huazhou, Zhigu, and other places, patrolling back and forth; branch seals were issued; they were to sign documents jointly; rotation every half year.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on the new moon of wuxu in the fourth month, each of the northern and southern military patrol offices was to assign one official to take command on the spot of patrol troops at Tongzhou, Huazhou, Zhigu, and other places, patrolling back and forth; branch seals were issued for joint administration, with rotation every half year.

sentences.zh: 特命烏古孫良楨得用軍器。

translations.literal: Ouyang Sun Liangzhen was specially authorized to use military weapons.
translations.idiomatic: Ouyang Sun Liangzhen was specially authorized to use military weapons.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以禮部所轄掌薪司並地土給付分司農司。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, the Fuelwood Office under the Ministry of Rites and its lands were given to the branch Agribureau.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, the Fuelwood Office under the Ministry of Rites and its lands were transferred to the branch agribureau.

sentences.zh: 以甘肅行省平章政事鎖南班為永昌宣慰使，總永昌軍馬，仍給平章政事俸。

translations.literal: Suonanban, chief minister of the Gansu Branch Secretariat, was made pacification commissioner of Yongchang, with overall command of Yongchang military forces, while still receiving chief minister's salary.
translations.idiomatic: Suonanban, chief minister of the Gansu branch secretariat, was appointed pacification commissioner of Yongchang with overall command of Yongchang military forces, while still receiving a chief minister's salary.

sentences.zh: 先是，永昌愚魯罷等為亂，鎖南班討平之，至是復起，故有是命。

translations.literal: Earlier, Yuluba and others had rebelled at Yongchang; Suonanban had suppressed them; now they rose again, hence this appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Yuluba and others had rebelled at Yongchang and Suonanban had suppressed them; now they had risen again, hence this appointment.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，太白犯井宿。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, Venus transgressed the Jing mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, Venus transgressed the Jing mansion.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，時享太廟。

translations.literal: On yisi day, seasonal offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, seasonal offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 己酉，詔取勘徐州、汝寧、南陽、鄧州等處荒田並戶絕籍沒入官者。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, an edict ordered surveying wasteland at Xuzhou, Runing, Nanyang, Dengzhou, and other places, and land escheated to the state from households extinct in the registers.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, an edict ordered the surveying of wasteland at Xuzhou, Runing, Nanyang, Dengzhou, and other places, along with land escheated to the state from extinct households in the registers.

sentences.zh: 立司牧署，掌分司農司耕牛。

translations.literal: A Herds Office was established to manage the plow oxen of the branch Agribureau.
translations.idiomatic: A Herds Office was established to manage the plow oxen of the branch agribureau.

sentences.zh: 又立玉田屯署。

translations.literal: A Yutian Garrison Office was also established.
translations.idiomatic: A Yutian Garrison Office was also established.

sentences.zh: 降徐州路為武安州，以所轄縣屬歸德府，其滕州、嶧州仍屬益都路。

translations.literal: Xuzhou Circuit was reduced to Wu'an Prefecture; its subordinate counties were placed under Guide Prefecture; Tengzhou and Yizhou remained under Yidu Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Xuzhou Circuit was reduced to Wu'an Prefecture; its subordinate counties were placed under Guide Prefecture, while Tengzhou and Yizhou remained under Yidu Circuit.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，太陰犯房宿。

translations.literal: On xinhai day, the moon transgressed the Fang mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, the moon transgressed the Fang mansion.

sentences.zh: 是月，車駕時巡上都。

translations.literal: That month, the imperial carriage made its seasonal tour to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the emperor made his seasonal tour to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 五月己巳，命東安州、武清、大興、宛平三縣正官添給河防職名，從都水監官巡視渾河堤岸，或有損壞，即修理之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on jisi day, the regular officials of Dong'an Prefecture and the three counties of Wuqing, Daxing, and Wanping were given additional river-defense titles; they were to follow Directorate of Waterways officials in inspecting the Hun River dikes and repair any damage at once.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the jisi day, the regular officials of Dong'an Prefecture and the three counties of Wuqing, Daxing, and Wanping were given additional river-defense titles and ordered to accompany Directorate of Waterways officials in inspecting the Hun River dikes and repairing any damage at once.

sentences.zh: 辛未，江西行省左丞相亦憐真班、江浙行省左丞老老引兵取道自信州，元帥韓邦彥、哈迷取道由徽州、浮梁，同復饒州，蘄、黃等賊聞風皆奔潰。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, Yeliqinban, left chief minister of the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat, and Laolao, left vice director of the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat, led troops by way of Xinzhou; marshals Han Bangyan and Hami took the route through Huizhou and Fuliang; together they recovered Raozhou; bandits of Qi and Huang and elsewhere fled and scattered at the news.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, Yeliqinban, left chief minister of the Jiangxi branch secretariat, and Laolao, left vice director of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat, led troops by way of Xinzhou, while Marshals Han Bangyan and Hami took the route through Huizhou and Fuliang; together they recovered Raozhou, and bandits in Qi, Huang, and elsewhere fled and scattered at the news.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以太尉阿剌吉為嶺北行省左丞相。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, Grand Marshal Alaji was made left chief minister of the Lingbei Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, Grand Marshal Alaji was appointed left chief minister of the Lingbei branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 知行樞密院事伯家奴封武國公，與諸王孛羅帖木兒同出軍。

translations.literal: Bojianu, acting director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was enfeoffed as Duke of Wu and took the field together with Prince Bolu Temür.
translations.idiomatic: Bojianu, acting director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was enfeoffed as Duke of Wu and took the field together with Prince Bolu Temür.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，行樞密院添設僉院二員。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, two additional vice directors were added to the mobile Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, two additional vice directors were added to the mobile Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，太陰犯歲星。

translations.literal: On yihai day, the moon transgressed Jupiter.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, the moon transgressed Jupiter.

sentences.zh: 乙未，泰州白駒場亭民張士誠及其弟士德、士信為亂，陷泰州及興化縣，遂陷高郵，據之，僭國號大周，自稱誠王，建元天祐。

translations.literal: On yiwei day, Zhang Shicheng of Baiju Pavilion in Taizhou and his brothers Shide and Shixin rebelled, seized Taizhou and Xinghua County, then seized Gaoyou and held it; he presumptuously declared the state name Great Zhou, styled himself King Cheng, and established the reign title Tianyou.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, Zhang Shicheng of Baiju Pavilion in Taizhou and his brothers Shide and Shixin rebelled, captured Taizhou and Xinghua County, then took Gaoyou and held it; he presumptuously declared the state name Great Zhou, styled himself King Cheng, and established the reign title Tianyou.

sentences.zh: 六月丙申朔，立詹事院，設詹事三員、同知二員、副詹事二員、丞二員。

translations.literal: Sixth month, bingshen new moon: the Household of the Heir Apparent was established, with three household heads, two associate directors, two deputy household heads, and two aides.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the new moon of bingshen, the Household of the Heir Apparent was established, with three household heads, two associate directors, two deputy household heads, and two aides.

sentences.zh: 命四川行省平章政事玉樞虎兒吐華便宜行事。

translations.literal: Yushu Huer Tuhua, chief minister of the Sichuan Branch Secretariat, was ordered to act at his discretion.
translations.idiomatic: Yushu Huer Tuhua, chief minister of the Sichuan branch secretariat, was authorized to act at his discretion.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，立皇子愛猷識理達臘為皇太子、中書令、樞密使，授以金寶，告祭天地、宗廟。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, the prince Ayushiridara was established as crown prince, director of the Secretariat, and commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs; the gold seal and treasure were conferred; Heaven and Earth and the ancestral temples were notified by sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, the prince Ayushiridara was installed as crown prince, director of the Secretariat, and commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs; the gold seal and regalia were conferred, and Heaven and Earth and the ancestral temples were notified by sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 命右丞相脫脫兼詹事。

translations.literal: Right Chief Minister Toto was ordered to serve concurrently as household head of the heir.
translations.idiomatic: Right Chief Minister Toto was ordered to serve concurrently as household head of the heir.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔征西都元帥汪只南發本處精銳勇敢軍一千人從征討，以千戶二員、百戶一十員領之。

translations.literal: On yihai day, an edict ordered the western campaign marshal Wangzhinan to dispatch 1,000 elite brave troops from his region for the punitive campaign, led by two commanders of thousands and ten commanders of hundreds.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, an edict ordered the western campaign marshal Wangzhinan to dispatch one thousand elite brave troops from his region for the punitive campaign, led by two commanders of thousands and ten commanders of hundreds.

sentences.zh: 庚子，知樞密院事失剌把都總河南軍，平章政事答失八都魯總四川軍，自襄陽分道而下，克復安陸府。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, Shilabatu, director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, took overall command of Henan forces; Dashibadu'er, chief minister, took overall command of Sichuan forces; descending separately from Xiangyang, they recovered Anlu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, Shilabatu, director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, took overall command of Henan forces and Dashibadu'er, chief minister, took overall command of Sichuan forces; descending separately from Xiangyang, they recovered Anlu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，罷宮傅府，以所掌錢帛歸詹事院。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, the Tutor's Office was abolished; the money and goods it managed were transferred to the Household of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, the Tutor's Office was abolished and the money and goods it managed were transferred to the Household of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，詔以敕牒二十道、鈔五萬錠，給付淮南行省平章政事達識帖睦邇，於淮南、淮北等處召募壯丁，並總領漢軍、蒙古守禦淮安。

translations.literal: On guimao day, an edict granted twenty appointment patents and 50,000 ingots of paper currency to Dash Temür, chief minister of the Huainan Branch Secretariat, to recruit able-bodied men in Huainan, Huaibei, and other regions, and to take overall command of Han and Mongol troops defending Huai'an.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, an edict granted twenty appointment patents and fifty thousand ingots of paper currency to Dash Temür, chief minister of the Huainan branch secretariat, to recruit able-bodied men in Huainan, Huaibei, and other regions and to take overall command of Han and Mongol troops defending Huai'an.

sentences.zh: 遼東搠羊哈及乾帖困、術赤術等五十六名吾者野人以皮貨來降，給搠羊哈等三人銀牌一面，管領吾者野人。

translations.literal: In Liaodong, Suoyangha and fifty-six Oirat tribesmen including Qiantiekun and Shuchishu came to submit with furs; Suoyangha and two others were each given a silver plaque to oversee the Oirat people.
translations.idiomatic: In Liaodong, Suoyangha and fifty-six Oirat tribesmen including Qiantiekun and Shuchishu came to submit with furs; Suoyangha and two others were each given a silver plaque to oversee the Oirat people.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以立皇太子詔天下，大赦。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, because the crown prince was established, an edict was issued to the empire and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, because the crown prince had been installed, an edict was issued throughout the empire and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 己酉，亦都護高昌王月魯帖木兒薨於南陽軍中，命其子桑哥襲亦都護高昌王爵。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, Yuelu Temür, protector-general and king of Gaochang, died in the army at Nanyang; his son Sangge was ordered to inherit the posts of protector-general and king of Gaochang.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, Yuelu Temür, protector-general and king of Gaochang, died in the army at Nanyang; his son Sangge was ordered to inherit the titles of protector-general and king of Gaochang.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，親王完者禿泰州陣亡，八禿亳州陣亡，各賻鈔五百錠。

translations.literal: On xinhai day, Princes Wanzhe Tu and Batu died in battle at Taizhou and Bozhou respectively; each was granted 500 ingots of paper currency as funeral gifts.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, Princes Wanzhe Tu and Batu were killed in battle at Taizhou and Bozhou respectively; each was granted five hundred ingots of paper currency as funeral gifts.

sentences.zh: 命前河西廉訪副使也先不花為淮西添設宣慰副使，討泰州。

translations.literal: The former vice commissioner of the Hexi surveillance commission, Yeshan Buhua, was appointed supplementary vice pacification commissioner of Huaixi to attack Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: The former vice commissioner of the Hexi surveillance commission, Yeshan Buhua, was appointed supplementary vice pacification commissioner of Huaixi to attack Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔皇太子位下立儀衛司，設指揮二員，給二珠金牌，副指揮二員，一珠金牌。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, an edict ordered establishment of a Ceremonial Guard Office under the crown prince, with two commanders granted two-pearl gold plaques and two deputy commanders granted one-pearl gold plaques.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, an edict ordered the establishment of a Ceremonial Guard Office under the crown prince, with two commanders granted two-pearl gold plaques and two deputy commanders granted one-pearl gold plaques.

sentences.zh: 賜吳王搠思監金二錠、銀五錠、鈔二千錠、幣帛各九匹。

translations.literal: Prince of Wu Suosijian was granted two ingots of gold, five ingots of silver, 2,000 ingots of paper currency, and nine bolts each of silks and fabrics.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Wu Suosijian was granted two ingots of gold, five ingots of silver, two thousand ingots of paper currency, and nine bolts each of silks and fabrics.

sentences.zh: 以資政院所轄左、右都威衛屬詹事院。

translations.literal: The Left and Right Capital Guards under the Privy Treasury were placed under the Household of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: The Left and Right Capital Guards under the Privy Treasury were placed under the Household of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 是月，命淮南行省平章政事達識帖睦邇便宜行事。

translations.literal: That month, Dash Temür, chief minister of the Huainan Branch Secretariat, was ordered to act at his discretion.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Dash Temür, chief minister of the Huainan branch secretariat, was authorized to act at his discretion.

sentences.zh: 詔淮南行省平章政事福壽討興化。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Fushou, chief minister of the Huainan Branch Secretariat, to attack Xinghua.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Fushou, chief minister of the Huainan branch secretariat, to attack Xinghua.

sentences.zh: 是夏，薊州大水。

translations.literal: That summer, Jizhou suffered great flood.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, Jizhou suffered severe flooding.

sentences.zh: 八月癸卯，親王闊兒吉思、帖木兒獻馬。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on guimao day, Princes Ku'erjisi and Temür presented horses.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the guimao day, Princes Ku'erjisi and Temür presented horses.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，賜脫脫東泥河田一十二頃。

translations.literal: On xinhai day, Toto was granted twelve qing of fields on the Dongni River.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, Toto was granted twelve qing of fields on the Dongni River.

sentences.zh: 親王只兒哈郎討捕金山賊，薨於軍中，命其子禿魯帖木兒入備宿衛。

translations.literal: Prince Zhierhalang, campaigning against the Jinshan bandits, died in the army; his son Tulu Temür was ordered to enter palace guard service.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Zhierhalang, campaigning against the Jinshan bandits, died in the army; his son Tulu Temür was ordered to enter palace guard service.

sentences.zh: 庚申，命不花帖木兒襲封文濟王。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, Buhua Temür was ordered to inherit the enfeoffment as Prince of Wenji.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, Buhua Temür was ordered to inherit the enfeoffment as Prince of Wenji.

sentences.zh: 是月，車駕還自上都。

translations.literal: That month, the imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the emperor returned from Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 資政院使脫火赤以兵復江州路。

translations.literal: Tuohuo Chi, commissioner of the Privy Treasury, recovered Jiangzhou Circuit with troops.
translations.idiomatic: Tuohuo Chi, commissioner of the Privy Treasury, recovered Jiangzhou Circuit with troops.

sentences.zh: 以四川行省平章政事玉樞虎兒吐華、右丞完者不花守鎮中興路。

translations.literal: Yushu Huer Tuhua, chief minister of the Sichuan Branch Secretariat, and Right Vice Director Wanzhu Buhua were ordered to guard and hold Zhongxing Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Yushu Huer Tuhua, chief minister of the Sichuan branch secretariat, and Right Vice Director Wanzhu Buhua were ordered to guard Zhongxing Circuit.

sentences.zh: 左遷平章政事咬住為淮西元帥，供給烏撒軍，進討蘄、黃。

translations.literal: Chief Minister Yaozhu was demoted to marshal of Huaixi, to supply the Wusa army and advance to attack Qi and Huang.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Minister Yaozhu was demoted to marshal of Huaixi, to supply the Wusa army and advance against Qi and Huang.

sentences.zh: 九月乙丑朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, yichou new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the new moon of yichou, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以怯薛官廣平王咬咬征討慢功，削其王爵，降為河南行省平章政事。

translations.literal: On yihai day, because the keshig officer and Prince of Guangping Yaoyao had been slow in the campaign, his princely rank was stripped and he was demoted to chief minister of the Henan Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, because the keshig officer and Prince of Guangping Yaoyao had been slow in the campaign, his princely rank was stripped and he was demoted to chief minister of the Henan branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 己丑，廣寧王渾都帖木兒薨，賻鈔一千錠。

translations.literal: On jichou day, Prince of Guangning Hundu Temür died; 1,000 ingots of paper currency were granted as funeral gifts.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, Prince of Guangning Hundu Temür died; one thousand ingots of paper currency were granted as funeral gifts.

sentences.zh: 建皇太子鹿頂殿於聖安殿西。

translations.literal: The crown prince's Stag-Top Hall was built west of the Sheng'an Hall.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince's Stag-Top Hall was built west of the Sheng'an Hall.

sentences.zh: 歪剌歹桑哥失裏獻馬一百匹，賜金系腰一、幣帛各九。

translations.literal: Wailaidai Sangge Shili presented one hundred horses and was granted one gold belt plaque and nine each of silks and fabrics.
translations.idiomatic: Wailaidai Sangge Shili presented one hundred horses and was granted a gold belt plaque and nine bolts each of silks and fabrics.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，太陰犯熒惑。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, the moon transgressed Mars.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, the moon transgressed Mars.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，紥你別之地獻大撒哈剌、察亦兒、米西兒刀、弓、鎖子甲及青、白西馬各二匹，賜鈔二萬錠。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, the land of Zhanibie presented great sabers of Sahala, Chayier, and Mixier, bows, mail armor, and two each of blue and white Western horses; 20,000 ingots of paper currency were granted.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, the land of Zhanibie presented great sabers of Sahala, Chayier, and Mixier, bows, mail armor, and two each of blue and white Western horses; twenty thousand ingots of paper currency were granted.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，太白經天，熒惑犯左執法。

translations.literal: On renchen day, Venus crossed the sky; Mars transgressed the Left Enforcement star.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, Venus crossed the sky and Mars transgressed the Left Enforcement star.

sentences.zh: 南臺御史大夫納麟以老疾辭職，從之，命太尉如故。

translations.literal: Nalin, censor-in-chief of the Southern Branch Censorate, resigned on grounds of age and illness; this was approved; he was ordered to remain grand marshal as before.
translations.idiomatic: Nalin, censor-in-chief of the southern branch censorate, resigned on grounds of age and illness; this was approved, and he was ordered to retain his post as grand marshal.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁酉，享於太廟。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on dingyou day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, on the dingyou day of the tenth month, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 庚子，太白經天。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, Venus crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, Venus crossed the sky.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以江浙行省參知政事買住丁升本省右丞，提調明年海運。

translations.literal: On guimao day, Maizhu, vice chief minister of the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat, was promoted to right vice director of that province and ordered to supervise next year's sea transport.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, Maizhu, vice chief minister of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat, was promoted to right vice director of that province and ordered to supervise the following year's sea transport.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，歲星犯氐宿。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, Jupiter transgressed the Di mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, Jupiter transgressed the Di mansion.

sentences.zh: 丁未，廣西元帥甄崇福復道州，誅賊將周伯顏。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, Zhen Chongfu, marshal of Guangxi, recovered Daozhou and executed the bandit general Zhou Boyan.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, Zhen Chongfu, marshal of Guangxi, recovered Daozhou and executed the bandit general Zhou Boyan.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，從帖裏帖木兒、左答納失裏之請，授方國珍徽州路治中，國璋廣德路治中，國瑛信州路治中，督遣之任，國珍疑懼，不受命。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, at the request of Tie'er Temür and Zuo Danashiri, Fang Guozhen was appointed administrative vice-director of Huizhou Circuit, Guozhang of Guangde Circuit, and Guoying of Xinzhou Circuit, and they were urged to take up their posts; Fang Guozhen was suspicious and afraid and did not accept the appointments.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, at the request of Tie'er Temür and Zuo Danashiri, Fang Guozhen was appointed administrative vice-director of Huizhou Circuit, Guozhang of Guangde Circuit, and Guoying of Xinzhou Circuit, and they were urged to take up their posts; Fang Guozhen, suspicious and afraid, did not accept the appointments.

sentences.zh: 立水軍都萬戶府於昆山州，以浙東宣慰使納麟哈剌為正萬戶，宣慰使董摶霄為副萬戶。

translations.literal: A Naval Commandery of Ten Thousand Households was established at Kunshan Prefecture; Nalin Hala, pacification commissioner of eastern Zhe, was made chief commander of ten thousand; Dong Bozhou, pacification commissioner, was made deputy commander of ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: A Naval Commandery of Ten Thousand Households was established at Kunshan Prefecture; Nalin Hala, pacification commissioner of eastern Zhe, was appointed chief commander of ten thousand, and Dong Bozhou, pacification commissioner, was appointed deputy commander of ten thousand.

sentences.zh: 庚申，賜皇太子妃鈔十萬錠。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, the crown prince's consort was granted 100,000 ingots of paper currency.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, the crown prince's consort was granted one hundred thousand ingots of paper currency.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，賜皇太子五愛馬怯薛丹二百五十人鈔各一百一十錠。

translations.literal: On renxu day, the crown prince's two hundred fifty beloved-horse keshig guards were each granted 110 ingots of paper currency.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, each of the crown prince's two hundred fifty beloved-horse keshig guards was granted one hundred ten ingots of paper currency.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，太白犯亢宿。

translations.literal: On guihai day, Venus transgressed the Kang mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, Venus transgressed the Kang mansion.

sentences.zh: 是月，撤世祖所立氈殿，改建殿宇。

translations.literal: That month, the felt hall established by Shizu was removed and palace buildings were rebuilt.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the felt hall established by Kublai was removed and permanent palace buildings were erected in its place.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬申，太陰犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on renshen day, the moon transgressed the Encampment Wall formation.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the renshen day, the moon transgressed the Encampment Wall formation.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，立典藏庫，貯皇太子錢帛。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, a Treasury Storehouse was established to hold the crown prince's money and goods.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, a treasury storehouse was established to hold the crown prince's money and goods.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，江西右丞火你赤以兵平富州、臨江，遂引兵復瑞州。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, Huonichi, right vice director of Jiangxi, pacified Fuzhou and Linjiang with troops, then led troops to recover Ruizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, Huonichi, right vice director of Jiangxi, pacified Fuzhou and Linjiang with troops, then led his forces to recover Ruizhou.

sentences.zh: 是月，立義兵千戶、水軍千戶所於江西，事平，願還為民者聽。

translations.literal: That month, righteous-army and naval commanderies of thousands were established in Jiangxi; when affairs were settled, those who wished to return to civilian status were permitted.
translations.idiomatic: That month, righteous-army and naval commanderies of thousands were established in Jiangxi; when the campaign was over, those who wished to return to civilian life were permitted to do so.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁酉，太白犯東咸。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on dingyou day, Venus transgressed Eastern Substance.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the dingyou day, Venus transgressed Eastern Substance.

sentences.zh: 己亥，寧王旭滅該還大斡耳朵思，賜金系腰一、鈔一千錠。

translations.literal: On jihai day, Prince of Ning Xu Miegai returned to the great ordo of Esen; he was granted one gold belt plaque and 1,000 ingots of paper currency.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, Prince of Ning Xu Miegai returned to the great ordo of Esen and was granted a gold belt plaque and one thousand ingots of paper currency.

sentences.zh: 庚子，熒惑入氐宿。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, Mars entered the Di mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, Mars entered the Di mansion.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，脫脫請以趙完普家產田地賜知樞密院事桑哥失裏。

translations.literal: On guimao day, Toto requested that the household property and fields of Zhao Wanpu be granted to Sangge Shili, director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, Toto requested that the household property and fields of Zhao Wanpu be granted to Sangge Shili, director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，京城天無雲而雷鳴，少頃，有火墜於東南。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, in the capital the sky was cloudless yet thunder pealed; shortly afterward, fire fell in the southeast.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, in the capital the sky was cloudless yet thunder pealed; shortly afterward, fire fell in the southeast.

sentences.zh: 淮慶路及河南府西北有聲如擊鼓者數四，已而雷聲震地。

translations.literal: In Huaiqing Circuit and northwest of Henan Prefecture there were four sounds like drumbeats; then thunder shook the earth.
translations.idiomatic: In Huaiqing Circuit and northwest of Henan Prefecture there were four sounds like drumbeats, and then thunder shook the earth.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以西安王阿剌忒納失裏為豫王；

translations.literal: On guichou day, Alatenashili, Prince of Xi'an, was made Prince of Yu;
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, Alatenashili, Prince of Xi'an, was made Prince of Yu;

sentences.zh: 弟答兒麻討南陽賊有功，以西安王印與之，命鎮寵吉兒之地。

translations.literal: his younger brother Darmma, for meritorious suppression of Nanyang bandits, was given the seal of the Prince of Xi'an and ordered to guard the lands of Chonggir.
translations.idiomatic: his younger brother Darmma, for meritorious service in suppressing the Nanyang bandits, was given the seal of the Prince of Xi'an and ordered to guard the lands of Chonggir.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，太陰犯心宿。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, the moon transgressed the Heart mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, the moon transgressed the Heart mansion.

sentences.zh: 西寧王牙罕沙鎮四川，還沙州，賜鈔一千錠。

translations.literal: Yahansha, Prince of Xining, who had guarded Sichuan, returned to Shazhou and was granted 1,000 ingots of paper currency.
translations.idiomatic: Yahansha, Prince of Xining, who had been stationed in Sichuan, returned to Shazhou and was granted one thousand ingots of paper currency.

sentences.zh: 是月，大同路疫，死者大半。

translations.literal: That month, Datong Circuit suffered plague; more than half died.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Datong Circuit was struck by plague, and more than half the population died.

sentences.zh: 江浙行省平章政事卜顏帖木兒、南臺御史中丞蠻子海牙及四川行省參知政事哈臨禿、左丞桑禿失裏、西寧王牙罕沙，合軍討徐壽輝於蘄水，敗之，壽輝遁走，獲其偽官四百餘人。

translations.literal: Buyan Temür, chief minister of the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat, Manzi Haiya, vice censor-in-chief of the Southern Branch Censorate, and Halintu, vice chief minister of the Sichuan Branch Secretariat, Sangtu Shili, left vice director, and Yahansha, Prince of Xining, combined forces to attack Xu Shouhui at Qishui, defeated him; Shouhui fled; more than four hundred of his pretender officials were captured.
translations.idiomatic: Buyan Temür, chief minister of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat, Manzi Haiya, vice censor-in-chief of the southern branch censorate, Halintu, vice chief minister of the Sichuan branch secretariat, Sangtu Shili, left vice director, and Yahansha, Prince of Xining, combined forces to attack Xu Shouhui at Qishui and defeated him; Shouhui fled, and more than four hundred of his rebel officials were captured.

sentences.zh: 陜西行省平章政事孛羅、四川行省右丞答失八都魯復均、房等州，詔孛羅等守之，答失八都魯討東正陽。

translations.literal: Boluo, chief minister of the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat, and Dashibadu'er, right vice director of the Sichuan Branch Secretariat, recovered Jun, Fang, and other prefectures; an edict ordered Boluo and others to hold them; Dashibadu'er was to attack eastern Zhengyang.
translations.idiomatic: Boluo, chief minister of the Shaanxi branch secretariat, and Dashibadu'er, right vice director of the Sichuan branch secretariat, recovered Jun, Fang, and other prefectures; an edict ordered Boluo and the others to hold them, while Dashibadu'er was to attack eastern Zhengyang.

sentences.zh: 是歲，自六月不雨至於八月。

translations.literal: That year, from the sixth month there was no rain until the eighth month.
translations.idiomatic: That year, from the sixth month until the eighth month there was no rain.

sentences.zh: 造清寧殿前山子、月宮諸殿宇，以宦官留守也先帖木兒、留守同知也速叠兒及都水少監陳阿木哥等董其役。

translations.literal: Before the Qingning Hall, rockeries, Moon Palace halls, and other structures were built; the eunuch palace commissioner Yeshan Temür, associate palace commissioner Yesu Dier, and Vice Director of Waterways Chen Amuge supervised the labor.
translations.idiomatic: Before the Qingning Hall, rockeries, Moon Palace halls, and other structures were built under the supervision of the eunuch palace commissioner Yeshan Temür, associate palace commissioner Yesu Dier, and Vice Director of Waterways Chen Amuge.

sentences.zh: 哈麻及禿魯帖木兒等陰進西天僧於帝，行房中運氣之術，號演揲兒法，又進西番僧善秘密法，帝皆習之。

translations.literal: Hami, Tulu Temür, and others secretly introduced Western Heaven monks to the emperor, practicing inner-chamber breath-circulation techniques called the Yanaḍar method; they also introduced Tibetan monks skilled in secret methods, and the emperor studied them all.
translations.idiomatic: Hami, Tulu Temür, and others secretly introduced Western Heaven monks to the emperor to practice inner-chamber breath-circulation techniques known as the Yanaḍar method; they also introduced Tibetan monks skilled in esoteric practices, and the emperor studied them all.

sentences.zh: 十四年春正月甲子朔，汴梁城東汴河冰，皆成五色花草如繪畫，三日方解。

translations.literal: Fourteenth year, spring, first month, jiazi new moon: the ice on the Bian River east of Bianliang city all formed into five-colored flowers and grasses like paintings; only after three days did it melt.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, on the new moon of jiazi in the first month of spring, the ice on the Bian River east of Bianliang formed patterns of five-colored flowers and grasses like paintings; only after three days did it melt.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，熒惑犯歲星。

translations.literal: On yichou day, Mars transgressed Jupiter.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, Mars transgressed Jupiter.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，太白犯建星。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, Venus transgressed the Establishment stars.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, Venus transgressed the Establishment stars.

sentences.zh: 辛未，享於太廟。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 壬申，命帖木兒不花襲封廣寧王，賜鈔一千錠。

translations.literal: On renshen day, Temür Buhua was ordered to inherit the enfeoffment as Prince of Guangning and was granted 1,000 ingots of paper currency.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, Temür Buhua was ordered to inherit the enfeoffment as Prince of Guangning and was granted one thousand ingots of paper currency.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，熒惑犯房宿。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, Mars transgressed the Fang mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, Mars transgressed the Fang mansion.

sentences.zh: 立遼陽等處漕運庸田使司，屬分司農司。

translations.literal: A Corvée-Farm Commissionerate for sea transport at Liaoyang and other places was established, subordinate to the branch Agribureau.
translations.idiomatic: A corvée-farm commissionerate for sea transport at Liaoyang and other places was established, subordinate to the branch agribureau.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，帝謂脫脫曰：「朕嘗作朵思哥兒好事，迎白傘蓋遊皇城，實為天下生靈之故。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, the emperor said to Toto: "I once performed the Dosi'er good ritual, welcoming the White Canopy to tour the Imperial City — it was truly for the sake of all living beings under Heaven."
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, the emperor said to Toto: "I once performed the Dosi'er good ritual, welcoming the White Canopy to tour the Imperial City — it was truly for the sake of all living beings under Heaven."

sentences.zh: 今命剌麻選僧一百八人，仍作朵思哥兒好事，凡所用物，官自給之，毋擾於民。

translations.literal: Now I order the lamas to select one hundred eight monks and again perform the Dosi'er good ritual; all materials used shall be supplied by the government and must not disturb the people.
translations.idiomatic: Now I order the lamas to select one hundred eight monks and again perform the Dosi'er good ritual; all materials used shall be supplied by the government and must not disturb the people.

sentences.zh: 」丙戌，以答兒麻監藏遙授陜西行省平章政事，實授行宣政院使，整治西番人民。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, Darmma Jancang was given titular appointment as chief minister of the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat and substantive appointment as commissioner of the mobile Bureau of Buddhist and Tibetan Affairs to regulate the Tibetan people.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, Darmma Jancang was given titular appointment as chief minister of the Shaanxi branch secretariat and substantive appointment as commissioner of the mobile Bureau of Buddhist and Tibetan Affairs to regulate the Tibetan people.

sentences.zh: 是月，命桑哥失裏、哈臨禿守中興。

translations.literal: That month, Sangge Shili and Halintu were ordered to guard Zhongxing.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Sangge Shili and Halintu were ordered to guard Zhongxing.

sentences.zh: 答失八都魯復峽州。

translations.literal: Dashibadu'er recovered Xiazhou.
translations.idiomatic: Dashibadu'er recovered Xiazhou.

sentences.zh: 二月戊戌，祭社稷。

translations.literal: Second month, on wuxu day, the altars of soil and grain were sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the wuxu day, sacrifices were offered at the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，命中書平章政事搠思監提調規運總管府。

translations.literal: On yimao day, Suosijian, chief minister of the Secretariat, was ordered to supervise the Directorate-General of Planned Transport.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, Suosijian, chief minister of the Secretariat, was ordered to supervise the Directorate-General of Planned Transport.

sentences.zh: 戊午，太白犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, Venus transgressed the Encampment Wall formation.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, Venus transgressed the Encampment Wall formation.

sentences.zh: 己未，以湖廣行省平章政事茍兒為淮南行省平章政事，以兵攻高郵。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, Gou'er, chief minister of the Huguang Branch Secretariat, was made chief minister of the Huainan Branch Secretariat and ordered to attack Gaoyou with troops.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, Gou'er, chief minister of the Huguang branch secretariat, was appointed chief minister of the Huainan branch secretariat and ordered to attack Gaoyou with troops.

sentences.zh: 是月，以呂思誠為湖廣行省左丞。

translations.literal: That month, Lü Sicheng was made left vice director of the Huguang Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Lü Sicheng was appointed left vice director of the Huguang branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 命湖廣行省右丞伯顏普化、江南行臺中丞蠻子海牙、江浙行省平章政事卜顏帖木兒、參知政事阿裏溫沙，會合湖廣行省平章政事也先帖木兒討沿江賊。

translations.literal: Bayan Buhua, right vice director of the Huguang Branch Secretariat, Manzi Haiya, vice censor-in-chief of the Jiangnan Branch Censorate, Buyan Temür, chief minister of the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat, and Aliwensha, vice chief minister, were ordered to join Yeshan Temür, chief minister of the Huguang Branch Secretariat, in suppressing bandits along the river.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan Buhua, right vice director of the Huguang branch secretariat, Manzi Haiya, vice censor-in-chief of the Jiangnan branch censorate, Buyan Temür, chief minister of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat, and Aliwensha, vice chief minister, were ordered to join Yeshan Temür, chief minister of the Huguang branch secretariat, in suppressing bandits along the Yangzi.

sentences.zh: 立鎮江水軍萬戶府，命江浙行省右丞佛家閭領之。

translations.literal: A Zhenjiang Naval Commandery of Ten Thousand Households was established; Fojialu, right vice director of the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat, was ordered to command it.
translations.idiomatic: A Zhenjiang Naval Commandery of Ten Thousand Households was established, and Fojialu, right vice director of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat, was ordered to command it.

sentences.zh: 詔河南、淮南兩省並立義兵萬戶府。

translations.literal: An edict ordered righteous-army commanderies of ten thousand households to be established in both Henan and Huainan provinces.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered righteous-army commanderies of ten thousand households to be established in both Henan and Huainan provinces.

sentences.zh: 建清河大壽元忠國寺，以江浙廢寺田歸之。

translations.literal: The Great Shouyuan Zhongguo Temple of Qinghe was built; abolished temple lands of Jiangzhe were assigned to it.
translations.idiomatic: The Great Shouyuan Zhongguo Temple of Qinghe was built, and abolished temple lands from Jiangzhe were assigned to it.

sentences.zh: 三月癸亥朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Third month, guihai new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the new moon of guihai, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 己巳，廷試進士六十二人，賜薛朝晤、牛繼誌進士及第，余授官出身有差。

translations.literal: On jisi day, sixty-two jinshi were examined at court; Xue Chaowu and Niu Jizhi were granted jinshi with honors; the rest received official appointments according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, sixty-two jinshi were examined at court; Xue Chaowu and Niu Jizhi were granted jinshi with honors, and the rest received official appointments according to rank.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以皇太子行幸，和買駝馬。

translations.literal: On renshen day, because the crown prince was traveling, camels and horses were purchased at set prices.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, because the crown prince was traveling, camels and horses were requisitioned at set prices.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，命親王速哥帖木兒以兵討宿州賊。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, Prince Suge Temür was ordered to take troops against the bandits of Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, Prince Suge Temür was ordered to lead troops against the bandits of Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙子，潁州陷。

translations.literal: On bingzi day, Yingzhou fell.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, Yingzhou fell.

sentences.zh: 是月，中書定擬義兵立功者權任軍職，事平授以民職，從之。

translations.literal: That month, the Secretariat drafted regulations that righteous-army men who achieved merit might temporarily hold military posts and, when affairs were settled, be granted civilian offices; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the Secretariat drafted regulations that righteous-army men who achieved merit might temporarily hold military posts and, when the campaign was over, be granted civilian offices; this was approved.

sentences.zh: 命四川行省右丞答失八都魯升本省平章政事兼知行樞密院事，總荊、襄諸軍，從宜調遣。

translations.literal: Dashibadu'er, right vice director of the Sichuan Branch Secretariat, was promoted to chief minister of that province with concurrent acting director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, given overall command of Jing and Xiang forces, and authorized to deploy them as circumstances required.
translations.idiomatic: Dashibadu'er, right vice director of the Sichuan branch secretariat, was promoted to chief minister of that province with concurrent acting director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, given overall command of the Jing and Xiang armies, and authorized to deploy them as circumstances required.

sentences.zh: 詔和買馬於北邊以供軍用，凡有馬之家，十匹內和買二匹，每匹給鈔一十錠。

translations.literal: An edict ordered purchase of horses on the northern frontier for military use; every household with horses was to sell two out of every ten at set price, ten ingots of paper currency per horse.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the purchase of horses on the northern frontier for military use; every household with horses was to sell two out of every ten at set price, receiving ten ingots of paper currency per horse.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸巳朔，汾州介休縣地震，泉湧。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, guisi new moon: Jiexiu County, Fenzhou, was struck by earthquake and springs gushed forth.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on the new moon of guisi in the fourth month, Jiexiu County in Fenzhou was struck by an earthquake and springs gushed forth.

sentences.zh: 以武祺參議中書省事。

translations.literal: Wu Qi was made deliberator of Secretariat affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Qi was appointed deliberator of Secretariat affairs.

sentences.zh: 是月，車駕時巡上都。

translations.literal: That month, the imperial carriage made its seasonal tour to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the emperor made his seasonal tour to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 江西、湖廣大饑，民疫癘者甚眾。

translations.literal: Jiangxi and Huguang suffered great famine; very many among the people were stricken with pestilence.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi and Huguang suffered severe famine, and pestilence afflicted a great many of the people.

sentences.zh: 御史臺臣糾言江浙行省左丞帖裏帖木兒等罪。

translations.literal: Censors of the Censorate impeached Tie'er Temür, left vice director of the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat, and others for crimes.
translations.idiomatic: Censors of the Censorate impeached Tie'er Temür, left vice director of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat, and others for crimes.

sentences.zh: 先是，帖裏帖木兒與江南行臺侍御史左答納失裏奉旨招諭方國珍，報國珍已降，乞立巡防千戶所，朝廷授以五品流官，令納其船，散遣徒眾，國珍不從，擁船一千三百餘艘，仍據海道，阻絕糧運，以故歸罪二人。

translations.literal: Earlier, Tie'er Temür and Zuo Danashiri, attendant censor of the Jiangnan Branch Censorate, had been ordered to summon Fang Guozhen; they reported that Fang Guozhen had submitted and requested establishment of a coastal patrol commandery of thousands; the court granted fifth-rank regular offices and ordered him to surrender his ships and disperse his followers; Fang Guozhen did not comply, kept more than 1,300 vessels, still held the sea routes, and blocked grain transport — hence blame fell on the two men.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Tie'er Temür and Zuo Danashiri, attendant censor of the Jiangnan branch censorate, had been ordered to summon Fang Guozhen; they reported that Fang Guozhen had submitted and requested establishment of a coastal patrol commandery of thousands. The court granted fifth-rank regular offices and ordered him to surrender his ships and disperse his followers, but Fang Guozhen did not comply, kept more than thirteen hundred vessels, still held the sea routes, and blocked grain transport — hence blame fell on the two men.

sentences.zh: 以江浙行省參知政事阿兒溫沙升本省右丞，浙東宣慰使恩寧普為江浙行省參知政事，皆總兵討方國珍。

translations.literal: Aliwensha, vice chief minister of the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat, was promoted to right vice director of that province; Eningpu, pacification commissioner of eastern Zhe, was made vice chief minister of the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat; all were given overall military command to attack Fang Guozhen.
translations.idiomatic: Aliwensha, vice chief minister of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat, was promoted to right vice director of that province, and Eningpu, pacification commissioner of eastern Zhe, was appointed vice chief minister of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat; all were given overall military command to attack Fang Guozhen.

sentences.zh: 發陜西軍討河南賊，給鈔令自備鞍馬軍器，合二萬五千人，馬七千五百匹，永昌、鞏昌沿邊人匠雜戶亦在遣中。

translations.literal: Shaanxi troops were dispatched against Henan bandits; paper currency was given for them to provide their own saddles, horses, and weapons; in all 25,000 men and 7,500 horses; craftsmen and miscellaneous households along the Yongchang and Gongchang frontiers were also among those sent.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi troops were dispatched against the Henan bandits; paper currency was given for them to provide their own saddles, horses, and weapons — in all twenty-five thousand men and seven thousand five hundred horses, with craftsmen and miscellaneous households along the Yongchang and Gongchang frontiers also among those sent.

sentences.zh: 造過街塔於盧溝橋，命有司給物色人匠，以御史大夫也先不花督之。

translations.literal: A street-crossing pagoda was built at the Lugou Bridge; the relevant offices were ordered to supply materials and craftsmen; Censor-in-Chief Yeshan Buhua supervised it.
translations.idiomatic: A street-crossing pagoda was built at the Lugou Bridge; the relevant offices were ordered to supply materials and craftsmen, and Censor-in-Chief Yeshan Buhua was placed in charge.

sentences.zh: 復立應昌、全寧二路。

translations.literal: Yingchang and Quanning circuits were re-established.
translations.idiomatic: Yingchang and Quanning circuits were re-established.

sentences.zh: 先是，有詔罷之，以撥屬魯王馬某沙王傅府，至是有司以為不便，復之。

translations.literal: Earlier, an edict had abolished them and assigned them to the tutor's office of Prince Maqusha of Lu; now the relevant offices deemed this inconvenient and restored them.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, an edict had abolished them and assigned them to the tutor's office of Prince Maqusha of Lu; now the relevant offices deemed this inconvenient and restored them.

sentences.zh: 詔復起永昌、鞏昌、喃巴、臨洮等處軍。

translations.literal: An edict ordered re-mobilization of troops at Yongchang, Gongchang, Nanba, Lintao, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the re-mobilization of troops at Yongchang, Gongchang, Nanba, Lintao, and other places.

sentences.zh: 命各衛軍人修白浮、甕山等處堤堰。

translations.literal: Troops of the various guards were ordered to repair the dikes and dams at Baifu, Wengshan, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Troops of the various guards were ordered to repair the dikes and dams at Baifu, Wengshan, and other places.

sentences.zh: 五月甲子，安豐、正陽賊圍廬州。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on jiazi day, bandits of Anfeng and Zhengyang besieged Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the jiazi day, bandits of Anfeng and Zhengyang besieged Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 是月，詔修砌北巡所經色澤嶺、黑石頭河西沿山道路，創建龍門等處石橋。

translations.literal: That month, an edict ordered repair of the mountain roads along Seze Ridge and west of Black Stone on the northern tour route, and construction of stone bridges at Longmen and other places.
translations.idiomatic: That month, an edict ordered the repair of mountain roads along Seze Ridge and west of Black Stone on the northern tour route, and the construction of stone bridges at Longmen and other places.

sentences.zh: 皇太子徙居宸德殿，命有司修葺之。

translations.literal: The crown prince moved to the Chende Hall; the relevant offices were ordered to repair it.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince moved to the Chende Hall, and the relevant offices were ordered to repair it.

sentences.zh: 立南陽、鄧州等處毛胡蘆義兵萬戶府，募土人為軍，免其差役，令討賊自效。

translations.literal: Righteous-army commanderies of ten thousand households of the Mao Hulu type were established at Nanyang, Dengzhou, and other places; local men were recruited as troops, exempted from corvée, and ordered to attack bandits to prove their merit.
translations.idiomatic: Righteous-army commanderies of ten thousand households of the Mao Hulu type were established at Nanyang, Dengzhou, and other places; local men were recruited as troops, exempted from corvée, and ordered to attack bandits to prove their merit.

sentences.zh: 因其鄉人自相團結，號毛胡蘆，故以名之。

translations.literal: Because the men of their native places had banded together among themselves and were called Mao Hulu, they were so named.
translations.idiomatic: Because the men of their native places had banded together among themselves and were called Mao Hulu, the commanderies were so named.

sentences.zh: 詔以玉樞虎兒吐華募兵萬人下蜀江，代答失八都魯守中興、荊門；

translations.literal: An edict ordered Yushu Huer Tuhua to recruit ten thousand troops and descend the Shu River, replacing Dashibadu'er in guarding Zhongxing and Jingmen;
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Yushu Huer Tuhua to recruit ten thousand troops and descend the Shu River, replacing Dashibadu'er in guarding Zhongxing and Jingmen;

sentences.zh: 命答失八都魯以兵赴汝寧。

translations.literal: Dashibadu'er was ordered to take troops to Runing.
translations.idiomatic: Dashibadu'er was ordered to take troops to Runing.

sentences.zh: 升湖廣行省參知政事阿兒灰為右丞，討廬州。

translations.literal: Arhui, vice chief minister of the Huguang Branch Secretariat, was promoted to right vice director and ordered to attack Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Arhui, vice chief minister of the Huguang branch secretariat, was promoted to right vice director and ordered to attack Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 募寧夏善射者及各處回回、術忽殷富者赴京師從軍。

translations.literal: Skilled archers of Ningxia and wealthy Muslims and Shihu from various places were recruited to come to the capital for military service.
translations.idiomatic: Skilled archers of Ningxia and wealthy Muslims and Shihu from various regions were recruited to come to the capital for military service.

sentences.zh: 復發禿卜軍萬人，命太傅阿剌吉領之。

translations.literal: Ten thousand Tubu troops were dispatched again; Grand Tutor Alaji was ordered to command them.
translations.idiomatic: Ten thousand Tubu troops were dispatched again, and Grand Tutor Alaji was ordered to command them.

sentences.zh: 命荊王答兒麻失裏代闊端阿合鎮河西，討西番賊。

translations.literal: Prince of Jing Darmmashili was ordered to replace Koden Aqa in guarding Hexi and suppressing Tibetan bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Jing Darmmashili was ordered to replace Koden Aqa in guarding Hexi and suppressing Tibetan bandits.

sentences.zh: 六月辛卯朔，薊州雨雹。

translations.literal: Sixth month, xinmao new moon: Jizhou was struck by hail.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the new moon of xinmao, Jizhou was struck by hail.

sentences.zh: 高郵張士誠寇揚州。

translations.literal: Zhang Shicheng of Gaoyou raided Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shicheng of Gaoyou raided Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙申，達識帖睦邇以兵討張士誠，敗績，諸軍皆潰。

translations.literal: On bingshen day, Dash Temür attacked Zhang Shicheng with troops, suffered defeat, and all armies fled in rout.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, Dash Temür attacked Zhang Shicheng with troops, suffered defeat, and all his armies fled in rout.

sentences.zh: 詔江浙行省參知政事佛家閭會達識帖睦邇，復進兵討之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Fojialu, vice chief minister of the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat, to join Dash Temür and again advance troops to attack him.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Fojialu, vice chief minister of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat, to join Dash Temür and again advance troops to attack Zhang Shicheng.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，太陰入斗宿。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, the moon entered the Dipper mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, the moon entered the Dipper mansion.

sentences.zh: 己酉，盱眙縣陷。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, Xuyi County fell.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, Xuyi County fell.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，陷泗州，官軍潰。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, Sizhou fell and government troops fled in rout.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, Sizhou fell and government troops fled in rout.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲子，潞州襄垣縣大風拔木偃禾。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jiazi day, a great wind in Xiangyuan County, Luzhou, uprooted trees and laid crops flat.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, on the jiazi day of the seventh month, a great wind in Xiangyuan County, Luzhou, uprooted trees and laid crops flat.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，太陰犯角宿。

translations.literal: On yichou day, the moon transgressed the Horn mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, the moon transgressed the Horn mansion.

sentences.zh: 壬申，詔免大都、上都、興和三路今年稅糧。

translations.literal: On renshen day, an edict exempted this year's tax grain for the Dadu, Shangdu, and Xinghe circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, an edict exempted this year's tax grain for the Dadu, Shangdu, and Xinghe circuits.

sentences.zh: 命刑部尚書阿魯於海寧州等處募兵討泗州。

translations.literal: Aru, minister of justice, was ordered to recruit troops at Haining Prefecture and other places to attack Sizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Aru, minister of justice, was ordered to recruit troops at Haining Prefecture and other places to attack Sizhou.

sentences.zh: 壬午，太陰犯昴宿。

translations.literal: On renwu day, the moon transgressed the Mao mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, the moon transgressed the Mao mansion.

sentences.zh: 是月，汾州孝義縣地震。

translations.literal: That month, Xiaoyi County, Fenzhou, was struck by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Xiaoyi County in Fenzhou was struck by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 八月，冀寧路榆次縣桃李花。

translations.literal: Eighth month: peach and plum trees blossomed in Yuci County, Jining Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, peach and plum trees blossomed in Yuci County, Jining Circuit.

sentences.zh: 車駕還自上都。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor returned from Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 九月己未朔，賜親王撒蠻答失金二錠、銀二十錠、鈔一萬錠、幣帛表裏各三百匹。

translations.literal: Ninth month, jiwei new moon: Prince Samandash was granted two ingots of gold, twenty ingots of silver, 10,000 ingots of paper currency, and three hundred bolts each of silks and fabrics for outer and inner garments.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the new moon of jiwei, Prince Samandash was granted two ingots of gold, twenty ingots of silver, ten thousand ingots of paper currency, and three hundred bolts each of silks and fabrics for outer and inner garments.

sentences.zh: 創設奧剌赤二十名，仍給衣糧草料。

translations.literal: Twenty olachi couriers were newly established and still given clothing, grain, and fodder.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty olachi couriers were newly established and provided with clothing, grain, and fodder.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以湖廣行省左丞呂思誠復為中書左丞。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, Lü Sicheng, left vice director of the Huguang Branch Secretariat, was restored as left vice director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, Lü Sicheng, left vice director of the Huguang branch secretariat, was restored as left vice director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以知樞密院事月闊察兒為中書平章政事。

translations.literal: On xinyou day, Yuekuo Cha'er, director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was made chief minister of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, Yuekuo Cha'er, director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was appointed chief minister of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 詔脫脫以太師、中書右丞相，總制諸王各愛馬、諸省各翼軍馬，董督總兵、領兵大小官將，出征高郵。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Toto, as grand preceptor and right chief minister of the Secretariat, to take overall command of the beloved horses of all princes and the wing forces of all provinces, supervise overall and leading commanders great and small, and campaign against Gaoyou.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Toto, as grand preceptor and right chief minister of the Secretariat, to take overall command of the beloved horses of all princes and the wing forces of all provinces, supervise commanders great and small, and lead the campaign against Gaoyou.

sentences.zh: 甲子，封高麗國王脫脫不花為沈王。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, Toghon Temür, king of Goryeo, was enfeoffed as Prince of Shen.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, Toghon Temür, king of Goryeo, was enfeoffed as Prince of Shen.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，普顏忽都皇后母歿，賻鈔三百錠。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, the mother of Empress Puyan Hudu died; 300 ingots of paper currency were granted as funeral gifts.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, the mother of Empress Puyan Hudu died; three hundred ingots of paper currency were granted as funeral gifts.

sentences.zh: 立寧宗影堂。

translations.literal: A spirit hall for Emperor Ningzong was established.
translations.idiomatic: A spirit hall for Emperor Ningzong was established.

sentences.zh: 戊子，免河南蒙古軍人雜泛差役。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, miscellaneous corvée duties of Mongol soldiers in Henan were exempted.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, miscellaneous corvée duties of Mongol soldiers in Henan were exempted.

sentences.zh: 是月，賜穆清閣工匠皮衣各一領。

translations.literal: That month, the craftsmen of the Muhua Pavilion were each granted one fur coat.
translations.idiomatic: That month, each of the craftsmen of the Muhua Pavilion was granted a fur coat.

sentences.zh: 蓋海青鷹房。

translations.literal: A sea-eagle mews was roofed over.
translations.idiomatic: A sea-eagle mews was roofed over.

sentences.zh: 禁河南、淮南酒。

translations.literal: Wine was prohibited in Henan and Huainan.
translations.idiomatic: The sale of wine was prohibited in Henan and Huainan.

sentences.zh: 階州西番賊起，遣兵擊之。

translations.literal: Tibetan bandits rose in Jiezhou; troops were dispatched to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: Tibetan bandits rose in Jiezhou, and troops were dispatched to attack them.

sentences.zh: 方國珍拘執元帥也忒迷失、黃巖州達魯花赤宋伯顏不花、知州趙宜浩，以俟詔命。

translations.literal: Fang Guozhen detained Marshal Yetiemishi, the darughachi of Huangyan Prefecture Song Boyan Buhua, and prefect Zhao Yihao, awaiting an imperial edict.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Guozhen detained Marshal Yetiemishi, the darughachi of Huangyan Prefecture Song Boyan Buhua, and Prefect Zhao Yihao, awaiting an imperial edict.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲午，享於太廟。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on jiawu day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, on the jiawu day of the tenth month, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔答失八都魯及泰不花等會軍討安豐。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, an edict ordered Dashibadu'er, Taibuhua, and others to combine forces and attack Anfeng.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, an edict ordered Dashibadu'er, Taibuhua, and others to combine forces and attack Anfeng.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔加號海神為輔國護聖庇民廣濟福惠明著天妃。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, an edict added to the title of the Sea God: "State-Supporting, Sage-Protecting, People-Sheltering, Broadly Benefiting, Blessing and Grace, Clearly Manifest Heavenly Consort."
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, an edict added to the title of the Sea God the honorific "State-Supporting, Sage-Protecting, People-Sheltering, Broadly Benefiting, Blessing and Grace, Clearly Manifest Heavenly Consort."

sentences.zh: 壬子，太陰犯太微垣。

translations.literal: On renzi day, the moon transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, the moon transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙寅，敕：「中書省、樞密院、御史臺，凡奏事先啟皇太子。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on bingyin day, an imperial command: "The Secretariat, Bureau of Military Affairs, and Censorate — for all memorials, first inform the crown prince."
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the bingyin day, an imperial command stated: "The Secretariat, Bureau of Military Affairs, and Censorate — for all memorials, first inform the crown prince."

sentences.zh: 」詔：「江浙應有諸王、公主、后妃、寺觀、官員撥賜田糧，及江淮財賦、稻田、營田各提舉司糧，盡數赴倉，聽候海運，以備軍儲，價錢依本處十月時估給之。

translations.literal: An edict: "All grain from allotted fields of princes, princesses, consorts, temples, and officials in Jiangzhe, and grain of the Jianghuai revenue, paddy-field, and garrison-farm commissioners, shall all be delivered to granaries to await sea transport for military stores; payment shall be at the local October market price."
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated: "All grain from allotted fields of princes, princesses, consorts, temples, and officials in Jiangzhe, and grain of the Jianghuai revenue, paddy-field, and garrison-farm commissioners, shall all be delivered to granaries to await sea transport for military stores; payment shall be at the local October market price."

sentences.zh: 」丁卯，脫脫領大兵至高郵，辛未，戰於高郵城外，大敗賊眾。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, Toto led a great army to Gaoyou; on xinwei day, battle was joined outside Gaoyou city and the bandit host was greatly defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, Toto led a great army to Gaoyou; on the xinwei day, battle was joined outside Gaoyou and the rebel forces were routed.

sentences.zh: 丙子，太陰犯鬼宿。

translations.literal: On bingzi day, the moon transgressed the Ghost mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, the moon transgressed the Ghost mansion.

sentences.zh: 癸未，賜親王喃答失金鍍銀印。

translations.literal: On guiwei day, Prince Nandash was granted a gold-plated silver seal.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, Prince Nandash was granted a gold-plated silver seal.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，脫脫遣兵平六合縣。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, Toto dispatched troops to pacify Liuhe County.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, Toto dispatched troops to pacify Liuhe County.

sentences.zh: 是月，答失八都魯復苗軍所據鄭、均、許三州。

translations.literal: That month, Dashibadu'er recovered the three prefectures of Zheng, Jun, and Xu held by Miao troops.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Dashibadu'er recovered the three prefectures of Zheng, Jun, and Xu, which had been held by Miao rebel forces.

sentences.zh: 皇太子修佛事，釋京師死罪以下囚。

translations.literal: The crown prince performed Buddhist rites and released prisoners in the capital below the death penalty.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince performed Buddhist rites and released prisoners in the capital below the death penalty.

sentences.zh: 十二辛卯，絳州北方有紅氣如火蔽天。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, xinmao day: north of Jiangzhou a red vapor like fire covered the sky.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the xinmao day, north of Jiangzhou a red vapor like fire covered the sky.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以中書平章政事定住為左丞相；

translations.literal: On bingshen day, Dingzhu, chief minister of the Secretariat, was made left chief minister;
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, Dingzhu, chief minister of the Secretariat, was appointed left chief minister;

sentences.zh: 宣政院使哈麻、永昌宣慰鎖南班並為中書平章政事，進階光祿大夫。

translations.literal: Hami, commissioner of the Bureau of Buddhist and Tibetan Affairs, and Suonanban, pacification commissioner of Yongchang, were both made chief ministers of the Secretariat and advanced to Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.
translations.idiomatic: Hami, commissioner of the Bureau of Buddhist and Tibetan Affairs, and Suonanban, pacification commissioner of Yongchang, were both appointed chief ministers of the Secretariat and advanced to Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.

sentences.zh: 監察御史袁賽因不花等劾奏：「脫脫出師三月，略無寸功，傾國家之財以為己用，半朝廷之官以為自隨。

translations.literal: Investigating censor Yuan Saiyin Buhua and others impeached: "Toto has been on campaign three months with scarcely a trace of merit, pouring the state's wealth to his own use and taking half the court's officials along with him."
translations.idiomatic: Investigating censor Yuan Saiyin Buhua and others impeached Toto, saying: "He has been on campaign for three months with scarcely a trace of merit, pouring the state's wealth to his own use and taking half the court's officials along with him."

sentences.zh: 又其弟也先帖木兒，庸材鄙器，玷汙清臺，綱紀之政不修，貪淫之心益著。
