translations.literal: "Moreover his younger brother Yeshan Temür is a mediocre talent of base character who has defiled the Pure Terrace; disciplinary government is not maintained and his greedy and licentious heart grows ever more manifest."
translations.idiomatic: "Moreover his younger brother Yeshan Temür is a mediocre talent of base character who has defiled the Censorate; disciplinary government is not maintained, and his greedy and licentious conduct grows ever more manifest."

sentences.zh: 」章三上，詔令也先帖木兒出都門聽旨，以宣徽使汪家奴為御史大夫。

translations.literal: The memorial was submitted three times; an edict ordered Yeshan Temür to leave the capital gate and await instructions; Wangjianu, commissioner of the Palace Provisionery, was made censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was submitted three times; an edict ordered Yeshan Temür to leave the capital and await instructions, and Wangjianu, commissioner of the Palace Provisionery, was appointed censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔以脫脫老師費財，已逾三月，坐視寇盜，恬不為意，削脫脫官爵，安置淮安路，弟御史大夫也先帖木兒安置寧夏路。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, an edict stated that Toto, as grand preceptor, had wasted resources; more than three months had passed while he sat watching bandits and thieves unconcerned; Toto's offices and ranks were stripped and he was placed at Huaian Circuit; his younger brother, Censor-in-Chief Yeshan Temür, was placed at Ningxia Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, an edict stated that Toto, as grand preceptor, had wasted state resources; more than three months had passed while he sat watching bandits and thieves unconcerned. Toto's offices and ranks were stripped and he was placed at Huaian Circuit; his younger brother, Censor-in-Chief Yeshan Temür, was placed at Ningxia Circuit.

sentences.zh: 以河南行省平章政事泰不花為本省左丞相，中書平章政事月闊察兒加太尉，集賢大學士雪雪知樞密院事，一同總兵，總領諸處征進軍馬，並在軍諸王、駙馬、省、院、臺官及大小出軍官員，其滅裏、卜亦失你山、哈八兒禿、哈怯來等拔都兒、雲都赤、禿兒怯裏兀、孛可、西番軍人、各愛馬朵憐赤、高麗、回回民義丁壯等軍人，並聽總兵官節制。

translations.literal: Taibuhua, chief minister of the Henan Branch Secretariat, was made left chief minister of that province; Yuekuo Cha'er, chief minister of the Secretariat, was made grand marshal; Xuexue, grand academician of the Hall of Gathered Worthies, was made director of the Bureau of Military Affairs; together they took overall military command and led expeditionary forces everywhere, including princes, imperial sons-in-law, provincial, bureau, and censorate officials, and all officers great and small on campaign, as well as badur, yunduchi, and other guards, Mieli, Buyishini, Haba'ertu, Haqilai, Tuerqiliwu, Boke, Tibetan troops, beloved-horse guards, Goryeo and Muslim righteous militia, and all others — all were to obey the overall commander's regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Taibuhua, chief minister of the Henan branch secretariat, was appointed left chief minister of that province; Yuekuo Cha'er, chief minister of the Secretariat, was made grand marshal; Xuexue, grand academician of the Hall of Gathered Worthies, was made director of the Bureau of Military Affairs. Together they took overall military command and led expeditionary forces everywhere, including princes, imperial sons-in-law, provincial, bureau, and censorate officials, and all officers great and small on campaign, as well as badur guards, yunduchi, and others, Mieli, Buyishini, Haba'ertu, Haqilai, Tuerqiliwu, Boke, Tibetan troops, beloved-horse guards, Goryeo and Muslim righteous militia, and all others — all were to obey the overall commander's orders.

sentences.zh: 詔：「被災殘破之處，令有司賑恤，仍蠲租稅三年。

translations.literal: An edict: "In places stricken by disaster and ravaged, let the relevant offices provide relief, and still remit rent and tax for three years."
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated: "In places stricken by disaster and ravaged, let the relevant offices provide relief and remit rent and tax for three years."

sentences.zh: 賜高年帛。

translations.literal: Silks were granted to the aged.
translations.idiomatic: Silks were granted to the elderly.

sentences.zh: 」罷庸田、茶運、寶泉等司。

translations.literal: The corvée-farm, tea transport, treasure spring, and other offices were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The corvée-farm, tea transport, treasure spring, and other offices were abolished.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以定住領經筵事，中政院使桑哥失裏為中書添設右丞。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, Dingzhu was made director of the Classics Colloquium; Sangge Shili, commissioner of the Central Government Bureau, was made additionally appointed right vice director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, Dingzhu was appointed director of the Classics Colloquium; Sangge Shili, commissioner of the Central Government Bureau, was appointed additionally as right vice director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 己亥，太陰掩昴宿。

translations.literal: On jihai day, the moon occulted the Mao mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, the moon occulted the Mao mansion.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以桑哥失裏同知經筵事。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, Sangge Shili was made associate director of the Classics Colloquium.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, Sangge Shili was appointed associate director of the Classics Colloquium.

sentences.zh: 冀國公禿魯加太尉，進階金紫光祿大夫。

translations.literal: Tulu, Duke of Ji, was made grand marshal and advanced to Grand Master of Golden Countersign and Purple Radiance.
translations.idiomatic: Tulu, Duke of Ji, was made grand marshal and advanced to Grand Master of Golden Countersign and Purple Radiance.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，命哈麻提調經正監、都水監、會同館，知經筵事，就帶元降虎符。

translations.literal: On guimao day, Hami was ordered to supervise the Directorate of Economic Regulation, Directorate of Waterways, and Joint Reception Hall, serve as director of the Classics Colloquium, and retain the tiger tally originally granted.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, Hami was ordered to supervise the Directorate of Economic Regulation, Directorate of Waterways, and Joint Reception Hall, to serve as director of the Classics Colloquium, and to retain the tiger tally originally granted him.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以桑哥失裏提調宣文閣；

translations.literal: On jiachen day, Sangge Shili was ordered to supervise the Hall of Propagating Culture;
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, Sangge Shili was ordered to supervise the Hall of Propagating Culture;

sentences.zh: 哈麻兼大司農，呂思誠兼司農卿，提調農務。

translations.literal: Hami concurrently headed the Grand Agribureau; Lü Sicheng concurrently served as director of the Agribureau, supervising agricultural affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Hami concurrently headed the Grand Agribureau, and Lü Sicheng concurrently served as director of the Agribureau, supervising agricultural affairs.

sentences.zh: 己酉，紹興路地震。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, Shaoxing Circuit was struck by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, Shaoxing Circuit was struck by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 是月，命織造世祖御容。

translations.literal: That month, an order was issued to weave Shizu's imperial portrait.
translations.idiomatic: That month, an order was issued to weave Kublai's imperial portrait.

sentences.zh: 詔威順王寬徹普化還鎮湖廣。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Prince of Weishun Wanchi Puhua to return and guard Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Prince of Weishun Wanchi Puhua to return and take up his post guarding Huguang.

sentences.zh: 先是以賊據湖廣，命奪其王印，至是寬徹普化討賊累立功，故詔還其印，仍守舊鎮。

translations.literal: Earlier, because bandits held Huguang, his princely seal had been ordered seized; now Wanchi Puhua had repeatedly achieved merit in suppressing bandits, hence an edict returned his seal and he still guarded his former post.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, because bandits held Huguang, his princely seal had been seized; now Wanchi Puhua had repeatedly achieved merit in suppressing bandits, and an edict therefore returned his seal and restored him to his former post.

sentences.zh: 命甘肅右丞嵬的討捕西番賊。

translations.literal: Weidi, right vice director of Gansu, was ordered to hunt down Tibetan bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Weidi, right vice director of Gansu, was ordered to hunt down Tibetan bandits.

sentences.zh: 答失八都魯復河陰、鞏縣。

translations.literal: Dashibadu'er recovered Heyin and Gong County.
translations.idiomatic: Dashibadu'er recovered Heyin and Gong County.

sentences.zh: 徭賊自耒陽寇衡州，萬戶許脫因死之。

translations.literal: Yao bandits from Leiyang raided Hengzhou; Commander of Ten Thousand Xu Tuoyin died.
translations.idiomatic: Yao bandits from Leiyang raided Hengzhou, and Commander Xu Tuoyin was killed.

sentences.zh: 是歲，詔諭：「民間私租太重，以十分為率普減二分，永為定例。

translations.literal: That year, an edict proclaimed: "Private rents among the people are too heavy; taking ten parts as the rate, universally reduce two parts, permanently as a fixed rule."
translations.idiomatic: That year, an edict proclaimed: "Private rents among the people are too heavy; taking ten parts as the standard, universally reduce them by two parts, permanently as a fixed rule."

sentences.zh: 」降鈔十萬錠賞江西守城官吏軍民。

translations.literal: One hundred thousand ingots of paper currency were granted to reward officials, soldiers, and civilians who defended cities in Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: One hundred thousand ingots of paper currency were granted to reward the officials, soldiers, and civilians who defended cities in Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 京師大饑，加以疫癘，民有父子相食者。

translations.literal: The capital suffered great famine, compounded by pestilence; among the people there were cases of fathers and sons eating one another.
translations.idiomatic: The capital suffered severe famine, compounded by pestilence; among the people there were cases of fathers and sons eating one another.

sentences.zh: 帝於內苑造龍船，委內官供奉少監塔思不花監工。

translations.literal: The emperor had a dragon boat built in the inner park and entrusted Inner Service Vice Commissioner Tasibuhua to supervise the work.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor had a dragon boat built in the inner park and entrusted Inner Service Vice Commissioner Tasibuhua to supervise the work.

sentences.zh: 帝自制其樣，船首尾長一百二十尺，廣二十尺，前瓦簾棚、穿廊、兩暖閣，後吾殿樓子，龍身並殿宇用五彩金妝，前有兩爪。

translations.literal: The emperor himself designed its form: bow to stern one hundred twenty feet long and twenty feet wide; in front, a tiled awning shed, connecting corridor, and two warmed chambers; behind, a Wu Hall tower; the dragon body and hall structures were decorated in five colors with gold; two claws in front.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor himself designed its form: one hundred twenty feet long and twenty feet wide from bow to stern; in front, a tiled awning shed, connecting corridor, and two warmed chambers; behind, a Wu Hall tower; the dragon body and hall structures were decorated in five colors with gold, with two claws in front.

sentences.zh: 上用水手二十四人，身衣紫衫，金荔枝帶，四帶頭巾，於船兩旁下各執篙一。

translations.literal: Above, twenty-four boatmen wore purple jackets, gold lychee belts, and four-tailed caps; one on each side below the boat held a pole.
translations.idiomatic: Above, twenty-four boatmen wore purple jackets, gold lychee belts, and four-tailed caps; one on each side below the boat held a pole.

sentences.zh: 自後宮至前宮山下海子內，往來遊戲，行時，其龍首眼口爪尾皆動。

translations.literal: From the rear palace to the lake below the front palace mountain they went back and forth in play; when moving, the dragon's head, eyes, mouth, claws, and tail all moved.
translations.idiomatic: From the rear palace to the lake below the front palace mountain they went back and forth in play; when the boat moved, the dragon's head, eyes, mouth, claws, and tail all moved.

sentences.zh: 又自制宮漏，約高六七尺，廣半之，造木為匱，陰藏諸壺其中，運水上下。

translations.literal: He also designed a palace clepsydra himself, about six or seven feet high and half as wide; a wooden cabinet was made, concealing various vessels within, with water driven up and down.
translations.idiomatic: He also designed a palace clepsydra himself, about six or seven feet high and half as wide; a wooden cabinet was made, concealing various vessels within, with water driven up and down.

sentences.zh: 匱上設西方三聖殿，匱腰立玉女捧時刻籌，時至，輒浮水而上。

translations.literal: On the cabinet was set a Hall of the Three Saints of the West; at the cabinet's waist stood jade maidens holding time rods; when the hour came, they floated up on the water.
translations.idiomatic: On the cabinet was set a Hall of the Three Saints of the West; at the cabinet's waist stood jade maidens holding time rods, and when the hour came they floated up on the water.

sentences.zh: 左右列二金甲神，一懸鐘，一懸鉦，夜則神人自能按更而擊，無分毫差。

translations.literal: On left and right stood two golden-armored spirits, one with a bell suspended, one with a gong; at night the spirit men could strike the watches by themselves without the slightest error.
translations.idiomatic: On left and right stood two golden-armored spirits, one with a bell suspended and one with a gong; at night the spirit figures could strike the watches by themselves without the slightest error.

sentences.zh: 當鐘鉦之鳴，獅鳳在側者皆翔舞。

translations.literal: When bell and gong sounded, lions and phoenixes at the sides all soared and danced.
translations.idiomatic: When the bell and gong sounded, the lions and phoenixes at the sides all soared and danced.

sentences.zh: 匱之西東有日月宮，飛仙六人立宮前，遇子午時，飛仙自能耦進，度仙橋，達三聖殿，已而復退立如前。

translations.literal: East and west of the cabinet were Sun and Moon palaces; six flying immortals stood before the palaces; at zi and wu hours the flying immortals could advance in pairs of their own accord, cross the immortal bridge, reach the Hall of the Three Saints, then withdraw and stand as before.
translations.idiomatic: East and west of the cabinet were Sun and Moon palaces; six flying immortals stood before the palaces, and at zi and wu hours the flying immortals would advance in pairs of their own accord, cross the immortal bridge, reach the Hall of the Three Saints, then withdraw and stand as before.

sentences.zh: 其精巧絕出，人謂前代所鮮有。

translations.literal: Its ingenuity was surpassing; people said the like was rarely seen in former ages.
translations.idiomatic: Its ingenuity was surpassing; people said the like was rarely seen in former ages.

sentences.zh: 時帝怠於政事，荒於遊宴，以宮女三聖奴、妙樂奴、文殊奴等一十六人按舞，名為十六天魔，首垂發數辮，戴象牙佛冠，身被纓絡、大紅綃金長短裙、金雜襖、雲肩、合袖天衣、綬帶鞋襪，各執加巴剌般之器，內一人執鈴杵奏樂。

translations.literal: At this time the emperor was slack in government affairs and dissolute in feasting and play; sixteen palace women — Sansheng Nu, Miaole Nu, Wenshu Nu, and others — performed arranged dances, called the Sixteen Heavenly Demons; their heads bore several braids of hair; they wore ivory Buddha crowns; their bodies were adorned with jeweled chains, great red silk gold long and short skirts, gold mixed jackets, cloud collars, heaven robes with joined sleeves, sashes, shoes, and socks; each held a kapala-bowl instrument; one within held a bell-staff and played music.
translations.idiomatic: At this time the emperor was slack in government affairs and dissolute in feasting and play; sixteen palace women — Sansheng Nu, Miaole Nu, Wenshu Nu, and others — performed arranged dances called the Sixteen Heavenly Demons. Their heads bore several braids of hair; they wore ivory Buddha crowns and were adorned with jeweled chains, great red silk gold long and short skirts, gold mixed jackets, cloud collars, heaven robes with joined sleeves, sashes, shoes, and socks. Each held a kapala-bowl instrument, and one among them held a bell-staff and played music.

sentences.zh: 又宮女一十一人，練槌髻，勒帕，常服，或用唐帽、窄衫，所奏樂用龍笛、頭管、小鼓、箏、緌、琵琶、笙、胡琴、響板、拍板。

translations.literal: Also eleven palace women, with practice-hammer chignons, headbands, and ordinary dress, sometimes wearing Tang caps and narrow jackets; the music they played used dragon flutes, lead pipes, small drums, zithers, ruan, pipa, sheng, huqin, clappers, and castanets.
translations.idiomatic: Also eleven palace women, with practice-hammer chignons, headbands, and ordinary dress, sometimes wearing Tang caps and narrow jackets, played music on dragon flutes, lead pipes, small drums, zithers, ruan, pipa, sheng, huqin, clappers, and castanets.

sentences.zh: 以宦者長安叠不花管領，遇宮中贊佛，則按舞奏樂。

translations.literal: The eunuch Chang'an Diebuhua was put in charge; when the palace praised the Buddha, they performed the dance and played music.
translations.idiomatic: The eunuch Chang'an Diebuhua was put in charge; when the palace held Buddhist rites, they performed the dance and played music.

sentences.zh: 宮官受秘密戒者得入，余不得預。

translations.literal: Only palace officials who had received secret initiation could enter; the rest were not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Only palace officials who had received secret initiation could enter; the rest were not permitted.
